description: This PHP class defines the 'OpenIdProvider' entity for Doctrine ORM, representing open ID provider configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like id, provider name, URL, and status, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OpenIdProvider
classes.description: Represents an OpenID provider with identity and status attributes, mapped to the 'ohrm_openid_provider' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the provider.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the provider.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderName
methods.description: Sets the name of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getProviderUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: setProviderUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL of the OpenID provider.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the active/inactive status of the provider.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the active/inactive status of the provider.
